g.text: [one names a hook or anything else]
the run stops before any hook
[the scenario or its feature carries a "@driver:" tag]
scan the Given, When and Then step attributes
each hook asks skipTag() for its own trait, and returns
on the trait's skip tag or enabled = FALSE, or records
the answer for the trait's step hooks and transforms
the backend already reached, else the first one listed
throw, naming the prerequisite and the
switches; the scenario fails, its steps are skipped
[a backend in the scenario's order implements it]
assertPrerequisites(trait) with no scope: the same
checks, run only when a scenario uses the step, and a
failure names no switch, since the switches stop only hooks
each hook asks skipTag() for its own trait, or reads
the answer its BeforeScenario hook recorded, and returns
on the trait's skip tag or enabled = FALSE
a teardown asks prerequisitesMet() and returns when
one does not hold, so it never replaces a recorded failure
